auth.heroAlt: Five diverse friends cheering over a tropical coastal town at sunset
auth.hook: Think you can out-travel your crew?
auth.birthdayHint: Saved once. Contact support to correct it later. Ages 13 and up can sign up; 13–17 join a trip with their Captain's code and approval.
auth.toSignin: Already have an account? Log in
auth.resetSent: If an account uses that email, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox.

error.tooYoung: Family Mode is coming soon. TripJunkies accounts are for ages 13 and up.
error.google: Google sign-in didn't work: {{reason}}. You can also use email below.
error.googlePopup: Google sign-in didn't work: {{reason}}. Pop-ups may be blocked — try again or use email below.

verify.title: Check your email
verify.expired: That code expired ⏰ Tap Resend for a fresh one.
verify.mismatch: Hmm, that code doesn't match 🙈 Double-check it and try again.
verify.spam: Can't find it? Peek in spam or promotions.

roomPlan.readyMadeHint: You get ready-made {{label}} cards to edit or replace. No AI credits used.

roomSetup.preflightDays: Pre-Flight warm-up days before you go (optional)

trip.name: Going on a Trip
trip.line: A group trip, at home or abroad.

window_seat.name: Window Seat
window_seat.line: Travel solo, or with a crew of up to 4.

explore_culture.name: Explore a Culture
explore_culture.line: Bring a culture home: cook it, learn it, play it.

show_culture.name: Show Your Culture
show_culture.line: Share your own culture with your crew.

game_night.name: Game Night
game_night.line: One night of games, any time. Free, no points.

solo.name: Just me
solo.line: Play every day on your own. Crowns come from hitting each season's goal.

crew.name: My crew (on the app)
crew.line: Everyone plays on their own phone and joins with the trip code.

offline.name: Friends off the app
offline.line: One phone runs the games. Names stay on this device; only you earn stamps.

where.title: Where to?
where.focusesHint: Cook it, learn it, wear it, play it.

basics.title: Trip basics
basics.dates: Tap your first and last day
basics.experienceDates: Tap your first and last experience day
basics.name: Trip name
basics.minorsHint: Turns on the family-friendly setup: no party cards, photos visible to leaders and the uploader only.
basics.zoneAsk: This place has more than one time zone. Which one is the trip in?

preflight.title: Pre-Flight
preflight.intro: The run-up before takeoff: quests, daily cards and call nights with your crew.
preflight.skipHint: Skipping means no Early Bird crown.
preflight.nightsHint: Video calls with the crew before the trip. Times are in your time ({{zone}}).
preflight.noNights: Pick at least one Pre-Flight day to add call nights.

season.title: Trip Season
season.intro: From arrival to the last day. It ends with the crowning night, where the Jet Setter is crowned.
season.introHome: Your experience days. They end with the finale night: present, vote, crown.
season.placeHint: A restaurant, the hotel rooftop, someone's living room…
season.callLink: Call link for anyone who can't be there (optional)

invite.title: Invite your crew
invite.offlineHint: First names only. They stay on this phone and nothing is saved for them.
invite.soloLine: Your trip is ready. Play fills in as each phase opens.

problem.name: Give your trip a name.
problem.dates: Tap your first and last day.
problem.datesPast: Pick dates that are still ahead of you.
problem.atHomeTomorrow: At-home experiences start tomorrow at the earliest. For tonight, start a Game Night.
problem.minorsParty: Trips with players under 18 can't use the party vibe.
problem.callNightTime: Pick a day and time for each call night.
problem.callNightWindow: Call nights happen during Pre-Flight, before takeoff day.
problem.callNightPast: Call nights need to be in the future.
problem.crowningDay: It has to be on one of the trip days.

banner.preflight: Now boarding. Your trip starts here.
banner.takeoff: Get ready for takeoff. Seatbelts on.
banner.baggage_claim: Thank you for flying with us. Collect your memories.

phases.arrivedHint: Tap when you land. Trip Season also starts on its own at 11:59 PM tomorrow, trip time.

nights.title: Call nights
nights.none: No call nights yet. The Captain or Co-Captain can add up to 4.
nights.crowningPending: The Captain picks the date, time and place.

tiles.title: By phase
tiles.preflight: Call nights, links and Pre-Flight days
tiles.baggage_claim: Break photo ties or swap one photo

gameNight.line: Game Night · free, just for fun · no points or crowns

daily.cardHint: One quick challenge a day · 1–2 pts
daily.played: Played today · a new one tomorrow

crewCheck.title: Crew Check
crewCheck.intro: One 👍 from anyone else approves a proof. No 👍 in 24 hours and it doesn't count.
crewCheck.photoHidden: In this trip the Captain and Co-Captain check photos.

quests.title: Your quests
quests.waiting: Sent · waiting for a 👍 from the crew
quests.speedHint: Open within 3 hours of the drop for +5

live.title: Game Night Live
live.lineCall: Present on the call, tap 👍 for each other and vote the awards
live.lineCrowning: Crowning night: present your trip quest and vote the awards
live.showTellHint: When someone finishes presenting, tap their avatar. The first 👍 gives them 20 points. You can't tap your own.
live.awardsHint: Pick one crewmate for each award. Votes stay secret until the Captain or Co-Captain closes.

standings.title: Standings
standings.empty: Points appear here as the crew plays.

drops.title: Surprise Drop
drops.scored: Scored after the drop closes and the crew checks the photos.

journey.title: Two seasons, two crowns
journey.intro: Points only count inside this trip. Each season has its own crown, decided by the most points; ties go to more Showcase points, then whoever got there first.
journey.earlyBirdLine: Daily Cards, sealed quests, Showcase and call nights before you go.
journey.jetSetterLine: Airport Missions, Surprise Drops, your trip quest and the crowning night.

journal.title: Tonight's journal
journal.label: Your entry
journal.hint: Type, or tap the mic on your keyboard to talk.

guide.title: Shared guide
guide.line: Built from your journal and quest photos
guide.showcaseLine: Your notes and photos, for your finale
guide.empty: Nothing here yet. Journal entries and approved quest photos appear here.
guide.privacyHint: Off until you turn them on. Photos never show publicly in trips with players under 18.
guide.shared: Shared · anyone with the link can read it
guide.leaderOnly: The Captain or Co-Captain shares the guide.
guide.publicMissing: This guide isn't shared right now.

offline.title: Offline
offline.never: Not synced on this phone yet
offline.hint: You're seeing your trip as of the last sync. Anything new needs a connection.
offline.waiting: Saved on this phone · sends when you're back online
offline.approveWaiting: 👍 saved · sends when you're back online

install.title: Install TripJunkies
install.why: Put it on your Home Screen so games, your trip and reminders work on the plane, even with no signal.
install.iosStep2: in Safari, then Add to Home Screen.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.installFirst: On iPhone, add TripJunkies to your Home Screen first (Share → Add to Home Screen), then open it from there to turn reminders on.
notifications.unsupported: This browser can't show reminders. Email reminders below still work.
notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked for TripJunkies in this browser's settings. Allow them there, then come back.
notifications.testSent: Sent. It should arrive in a few seconds.
notifications.quietHint: No reminders between these times (your time zone). Anything due then waits until they end.
notifications.cardWhy: Get the daily tip, call nights and drops when they happen. Change what you get in Me → Notifications.

postcard.title: Trip Postcard
postcard.picksLine_one: Pick your favourite photo for the Trip Postcard. Swap it any time.
postcard.picksLine_other: Pick your {{count}} favourite photos for the Trip Postcard. Swap them any time.
postcard.noPhotos: Your quest and drop photos show up here. Pick your favourites for the postcard.
postcard.pick: Pick this photo for the postcard
postcard.unpick: Remove this photo from your picks
postcard.fullHint: All picked. Tap a picked photo to swap it.
postcard.heartLine: The {{count}} photos with the most hearts go on the postcard.
postcard.noCrewPicks: The crew didn't pick any photos.
postcard.questionsLine: Short answers in your own words. They go on the postcard with no names.
postcard.downloadLine: After Day 7 only the postcard photos are kept. Save yours now.
postcard.captainLine: {{count}} photos go on the postcard. You can break ties at the cut or swap one photo.
postcard.captainLater: Opens in wrap-up week, the day after the trip.
postcard.swapHint: One swap per trip: tap Swap out on a photo, then Swap in on another pick.
postcard.tieHint: Tied photos at the cut can be broken in favour of one.
postcard.afterLine: This trip is wrapped. Its postcard is in everyone's passport.
